fails_if: the SOS parser checks only that its path exists (or hands any path to openpyxl), so an existing directory, or a missing file, fails with an unlocated read error instead of the not-a-regular-file refusal
note: The hardest form of the regular-file check: the path exists. The missing-file test was its easy twin (a missing path also fails inside openpyxl, so it passed without the check).
